Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-the-trulli-of-alberobello-brundis.story: A 263 km round trip from Alberobello - roughly 4 h 32 in the saddle. On the way it passes Tarentum, The Via Appia from Mesochorum to Scamnum, Brundisium and back through The Via Appia from Mesochorum to Scamnum. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
